pattern.description: Python re-syntax regular expression to search file contents for.

path.description: A single file path or a folder path to search under. Must be within your flow's allowed files (the files attached to this flow); root/whole-bucket search is not available - pass one of your allowed paths.

recursive.description: When path is a folder, descend into every nested folder instead of only its direct files. Defaults to true.

show_line_numbers.description: Prefix each matching line with its line number. Defaults to true.

files_with_matches.description: Return only the paths of files containing a match, instead of the matching lines themselves. Defaults to false.
